selection_query: with eligible as (select a.*,s.name source_name,s.active source_active,s.source_adapter,v.latitude,v.longitude,case when v.latitude is not null and v.longitude is not null then 6371*2*asin(least(1.0,sqrt(power(sin(radians(v.latitude-51.508924)/2),2)+cos(radians(51.508924))*cos(radians(v.latitude))*power(sin(radians(v.longitude+0.275866)/2),2)))) end distance_km from current_activities a left join sources s on s.id=a.source_id left join venues v on v.id=a.venue_id), ranked as (select *,row_number() over(partition by coalesce(category,'unknown'),coalesce(source_id::text,'unknown') order by md5(id::text)) stratum_rank from eligible) select jsonb_build_object('captured_at',now(),'pool_count',(select count(*) from ranked),'rows',(select jsonb_agg(t order by case when distance_km<=10 then 0 else 1 end,stratum_rank,category,source_id,id) from (select * from ranked order by case when distance_km<=10 then 0 else 1 end,stratum_rank,category,source_id,id limit 100)t)) pack
